name: universal-ai-browser-bridge
description: Two standalone projects: a Chrome MV3 extension and the Cloudflare gateway that pairs it with AI clients over MCP.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix cloudflare install && npm --prefix extension install
scripts.build: npm run sync:contracts && npm --prefix cloudflare run build && npm --prefix extension run build
scripts.package:extension: npm run sync:contracts && npm run check:contracts && npm --prefix extension run build && node scripts/package-extension.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix cloudflare run typecheck && npm --prefix extension run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix cloudflare test && npm --prefix extension test
